bio.zh: 丁悦，上海交通大学医学院附属精神卫生中心神经影像平台助理研究员、硕士生导师。博士毕业于清华大学医学院生物医学工程专业，曾赴约翰霍普金斯大学访学。研究聚焦无创物理干预的神经机制及其在精神障碍中的应用，结合脑机接口、神经调控、情感计算与音乐干预，探索面向精神健康的个体化干预方法。
bio.en: Yue Ding is an Assistant Research Fellow and master’s supervisor at the Neuroimaging Platform of Shanghai Mental Health Center, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine. Yue received a Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering from Tsinghua University and was a visiting scholar at Johns Hopkins University. Her research investigates the neural mechanisms of non-invasive physical interventions and their applications in mental disorders, bringing together brain–computer interfaces, neuromodulation, affective computing, and music-based interventions.
